name: Hiranai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Hiranai town emblem in white: an outlined cherry blossom enclosing a ring with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Hiranai, a town in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 March 1963.

features.role: Hiranai town emblem — an outlined cherry blossom enclosing a ring with a stylised character
